scrim.need_both_sides: need players on both CT and T to start.
scrim.need_both_sides_bots: need players (or bots) on both CT and T to start.
scrim.start_failed: could not start the scrim; still in warmup.
scrim.all_ready_knife_one: all {count} player ready - knife round in {seconds}s (.ur to cancel).
scrim.all_ready_knife_other: all {count} players ready - knife round in {seconds}s (.ur to cancel).
scrim.all_ready_live_one: all {count} player ready - going live in {seconds}s (.ur to cancel).
scrim.all_ready_live_other: all {count} players ready - going live in {seconds}s (.ur to cancel).
scrim.starting: scrim starting - restarting the game, LIVE after the restart.
scrim.golive_failed: scrim created but the go-live commands could not be queued.
scrim.warmup: scrim warmup - type .r when ready ({ready}/{total} ready). Goes live when everyone on CT/T is ready.
knife.after_restart: KNIFE ROUND after the restart - knives only, the winning team picks its side.
knife.started: KNIFE! Winning team picks the side.
knife.picked_stay: {team} start on {side} (sides stay) - LIVE after the restart.
knife.picked_swap: {team} start on {side} (teams swapped) - LIVE after the restart.
knife.picked_timeout_stay: {team} (no pick in time) start on {side} (sides stay) - LIVE after the restart.
knife.picked_timeout_swap: {team} (no pick in time) start on {side} (teams swapped) - LIVE after the restart.
knife.won_elimination: {team} won the knife round ({side} eliminated the other team).
knife.won_more_alive: {team} won the knife round (time ran out, more players alive (CT {ct_alive} alive/{ct_hp} HP vs T {t_alive} alive/{t_hp} HP)).
knife.won_more_hp: {team} won the knife round (time ran out, more HP left (CT {ct_alive} alive/{ct_hp} HP vs T {t_alive} alive/{t_hp} HP)).
knife.won_coin_flip: {team} won the knife round (time ran out, dead even (CT {ct_alive} alive/{ct_hp} HP vs T {t_alive} alive/{t_hp} HP), random pick).
knife.bots_only: only bots on the winning side - keeping sides.
knife.pick_prompt: {team} players: type .stay or .switch (.ct / .t) - {seconds}s, then sides stay.
match.loaded: match loaded. Type .r or .ready to ready up.
match.damage_decides: {score1}-{score2} after the overtimes, so total damage decides: {winner} wins the map ({team1} {damage1} - {damage2} {team2}).
golive.tie_overtime: at {half}-{half}, overtime: {ot_rounds} rounds, first to {ot_to_win}, until someone wins.
golive.tie_overtime_damage: at {half}-{half}, overtime: {ot_rounds} rounds, first to {ot_to_win}, at most {max_ot}, then total damage decides.
golive.tie_overtime_draw: at {half}-{half}, overtime: {ot_rounds} rounds, first to {ot_to_win}, at most {max_ot}, then a draw.
golive.tie_draw: at {half}-{half}, the map is a draw.
player.left_goes_on: {name} ({team}) left the server. The match goes on; they can rejoin with the same connect link.
player.left_pauses: {name} ({team}) left the server. The match pauses at the next freeze time until they are back.
player.left_pauses_max: {name} ({team}) left the server. The match pauses at the next freeze time until they are back (at most {minutes} min).
help.title: Ready Up commands:
help.scrim_knife: scrim: when everyone on CT/T is READY: 5s countdown, knife round, winners .stay/.switch, live.
help.scrim: scrim: when everyone on CT/T is READY, a 5s countdown starts and the scrim goes live.
reply.leaderboard_needs_hud: The leaderboard needs the Auto Tournament HUD.
reply.spec_on_roster: you are on this match's roster: ask an admin to move you
reply.spec_failed: could not move you to spectators (team change is not available on this CS2 build): use the team menu
ready.not_on_roster: you are not on this match's roster.
ready.no_side_pick_no_match: no knife side pick pending (no match loaded).
ready.live_only: {command} only works during a live match.
ready.not_in_practice: ready-up is not used in practice mode.
ready.not_in_mode: ready-up is not used in {mode} mode.
ready.scrim_off: scrim warmup is off (admin: .ru mode scrim to enable).
pause.unavailable_build: pauses are unavailable on this server build (see `ru selftest`).
forfeit.captain_only: only the team captain can forfeit.
reply.practice_not_loaded: practice mode needs the practice plugin (practice.so), which is not loaded.
reply.side_invalid: invalid choice. Use: .ru match side stay|switch|ct|t
knife.winner_only: only the knife-winning team can pick sides.
reply.start_needs_gotv: match not started (GOTV is off under the valve ruleset: .ru match start force).
